name: BIETEN
description: Bieten (German: 'Bidding' or 'Offering') is a highly unusual gambling game from the Austrian Tyrol played with a 33-card German-suited pack including the iconic WELI wild card. Each player receives only 3 cards, and points are scored for having the best Heart card, the best Leaf card, the best pair/triple, the best sequence, and winning the last trick. Players can 'Bieten' (bet) on any of these categories, escalating the stakes, or their opponents can concede the point. It is essentially a multi-dimensional bluffing game.

content.text: Bieten (German: 'Bidding' or 'Offering') is a highly unusual gambling game from the Austrian Tyrol played with a 33-card German-suited pack including the iconic WELI wild card. Each player receives only 3 cards, and points are scored for having the best Heart card, the best Leaf card, the best pair/triple, the best sequence, and winning the last trick. Players can 'Bieten' (bet) on any of these categories, escalating the stakes, or their opponents can concede the point. It is essentially a multi-dimensional bluffing game.
Rooted deeply in the Austrian Tyrol and Bavarian card-game tradition. The WELI card is a hallmark of Tyrolean card games. Bieten draws on the same tradition as Watten and Schnapsen.
33-card German-suited pack: A, K, Over (O), Under (U), 10, 9, 8, 7 in 4 suits (Hearts/Rot, Leaves/GrÃ¼n, Bells/Schellen, Acorns/Eichel) + WELI (special 6 of Bells wild card).
Deal 3 cards to each player. No trump is established. No kitty.

items.text: Weli as Fixed Bonus: Weli is not wild; instead its holder scores a bonus point automatically.
Triple Wild Variant: WELI, 7 of Bells, and 7 of Acorns are all wild. All rank below the real cards they represent.
